notes.title: Evil Tonight is now available for purchase on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39210701/1fc72f46748e682e10394b7b744ed047a8fc54e8.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1480830/Evil_Tonight/

Hello, Everyone!

[b]Evil Tonight[/b] is now available for purchase on Steam!

We are proud to announce this is our [b]best work[/b] to date... and we truly hope you'll enjoy all the [b]love[/b] and [b]effort[/b] we've put into every single aspect of this project.

The game is also available on [b][url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/evil-tonight-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url][/b] (Europe, Australia and Americas only).

Also, the [i]Evil Tonight Soundtrack[/i] is available for purchase! - [url=https://scarletmoonrecords.bandcamp.com/album/evil-tonight-original-game-soundtrack]Bandcamp[/url] | [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/2eZ3nraS5CyBtjJfq1xujX]Spotify[/url] | [url=https://music.apple.com/es/album/evil-tonight-original-game-soundtrack/1588792198]Apple Music[/url]

That's all for now... enjoy the adventure!

[i]DYA GAMES[/i]

notes.title: Evil Tonight – Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39210701/43d93dc592dab8651d73f3401e40e7bb99b22747.png[/img]

Hello, Everyone!

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1480830/Evil_Tonight/]Evil Tonight[/url][/b] is finally releasing on [b]October 14th 2021[/b], which is right around the corner and right on time for an early [i]Halloween[/i] surprise! Please add the game to your [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1480830/Evil_Tonight/]WISHLIST[/url][/b] and follow the project for announcements, as well as to make sure you don’t miss out on our [b]launch discount[/b]!

The game will also be available on [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] (Europe, Australia and Americas only).

That's all for now!
